title: Tells CLI release manifest
description: Where the tells command is published and how people install it. schemas/cli-release.json is the source of truth for the npm package name, the bin name, the Homebrew tap and formula, and the install commands the docs and tells --help print. package.json, the publish workflow and the Homebrew formula renderer must agree with it. The version is not here: it comes from the release tag.

name.description: npm package name. Unscoped and lowercase.

bin.description: The command the package puts on PATH.

entry.description: Package-relative path of the bin script.

repository.description: GitHub owner/name of the public repo that publishes the package.

install.description: One-time global install. Must name package.name.

publish_workflow.description: Workflow file under .github/workflows/ that npm trusts to publish (OIDC trusted publishing).

tap_repository.description: GitHub repo that holds the tap. Homebrew requires the homebrew- prefix.

tap.description: The tap name users type: the repo with the homebrew- prefix dropped.

desc.description: Formula desc. Homebrew audit: at most 80 characters, no leading article, no trailing period. No quote, backslash or hash so it stays a plain Ruby string.

command.description: Secondary path with no global install: run the default branch straight from GitHub.
